# Proficiency

*[Rules Glossary](../index.md) > [D20 Tests](index.md) | [D&D Beyond](https://www.dndbeyond.com/sources/dnd/br-2024/rules-glossary#Proficiency)*

If you have proficiency with something, you can add your Proficiency Bonus to any [D20 Test](D20-Test.md) you make using that thing. A creature might have proficiency in a skill or saving throw or with a weapon or tool. *See also* "Playing the Game" ("[Proficiency](https://www.dndbeyond.com/sources/dnd/br-2024/playing-the-game#Proficiency)").
